digest.component_or_area: plan-review coaching moves and criterion routing
propositions: A project-only criterion and advisory coaching move must detect when a plan's affected-file or call-site inventory was enumerated by hand rather than derived from the symbol graph, and direct re-derivation using find_referencing_symbols and string-literal sweeps.

The criterion must route to plan_review only (not code_review) because project.* criterion ids cannot fire code_review moves, which draw applies_when tags from a closed vocabulary; plan_review's trigger union includes project criterion ids as proven by the existing project.portability pattern.

Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven via code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring is required and shipped defaults remain unchanged.

Detection of incomplete source-reference inventory is demonstrated live with validity 1.0 and correctly names omitted files including string-literal monkeypatch sites that the LSP cannot resolve; however, method coaching selection is controlled by the LLM rather than configuration and does not reliably reach agents when blocking built-ins G1G2/G6/E4 fire on the same evidence.

The criterion must carry default_posture advisory and no inert blocking_enabled key, with move applicability proven deterministically in tests and working correctly for complete inventories (criterion abstains) and incomplete ones (criterion fires but does not block).
